summary: Remote WebSocket relay grants full-host RCE via PTY, subprocess, and filesystem handlers
details: On startup, the package opens a WebSocket client to a relay endpoint (default wss://msclaude.ai) and wires server-sent messages to handlers that spawn an interactive PTY (node-pty running bash or powershell) whose stdin is fed from relay messages, spawn Claude Code as a subprocess with prompts supplied by the relay, read and write arbitrary files, run git operations, and proxy HTTP/WebSocket traffic to localhost ports. Anyone controlling the relay endpoint therefore has arbitrary command execution, arbitrary file read/write, and localhost network pivot on the installer's host. The tarball also ships a postinstall bridge (scripts/install-bridge.cjs) that, for -g installs, fetches a runtime manifest from an env-overridable URL and stages a runtime bundle into the version store.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
